important_actions: action: Survived birth during active combat assault by the Zombra swarm.; source_refs: ['435_The_Metabarons_17_p08-p09']
action: Crawled unharmed through mental beams during battle at the Golden Planet.; source_refs: ['444_The_Metabarons_17_p18']
action: Diamond-bright eyes appear to have neutralized the psychic attackers threatening the Empress (implied, not explicitly confirmed).; source_refs: ['445_The_Metabarons_17_p19']
knowledge_boundaries: Infant; no knowledge or intent attributable beyond possible innate powers.
Future backstory flagged by narrator: harsh training and a scar over the right eyebrow to be explained in subsequent episodes.
relationships: character: Aghora; nature: Parent; Aghora is referred to as 'father-mother'; Aghora refuses to give the child a personal name; source_refs: ['444_The_Metabarons_17_p18', '446_The_Metabarons_17_p20']
traits: Unusually alert and adult-like in expression for a newborn
Immune to or unaffected by mental beam attacks
Diamond-bright glowing eyes; implied connection to the destruction of the psychic attacking force
voice_notes: Laughs in a way narration describes as adult-like, treated as abnormal and significant.
witnessed_facts: fact: Born during the Zombra assault on Rock Dragonis while Aghora climbed and the Metabaron fought rearguard.; source_refs: ['435_The_Metabarons_17_p08-p09']
fact: Escaped Flos with Aghora through the pollen layer aboard the Metacraft; fed artificial milk because Aghora could not nurse.; source_refs: ['439_The_Metabarons_17_p13']
fact: Crawled unharmed between Aghora (kneeling) and an androgynous monkey-like figure through crossing mental beams.; source_refs: ['444_The_Metabarons_17_p18']
fact: His diamond-bright eyes appeared to be associated with the destruction of the psychic attacking force at the Golden Planet battle.; source_refs: ['445_The_Metabarons_17_p19']
fact: Formally honored by the imperial court with a high-nobility medallion, the title Trino-Viscount, and three billion kiblars.; source_refs: ['445_The_Metabarons_17_p19']
fact: Designated 'No-Name' by Aghora; declared destined to be the perfect warrior and supreme technopope.; source_refs: ['446_The_Metabarons_17_p20']
